changelog:
- Initial release of the "write-planning-document" skill.
- Generates comprehensive planning documents based on user-provided topics and core objectives.
- Includes standardized structure: objectives, background, implementation plan (by phase), resources/budget, performance evaluation, risk response, and execution roadmap.
- Ensures clarity and innovation with goal orientation, concise tables, and at least two innovative highlights in each plan.
- Provides budget transparency and quantifiable KPIs, with built-in risk awareness and time sensitivity reminders.
